name: aip1-guardian-huawei
description: Silent Guardian — a discreet personal-safety companion. Write a calm note, pick a situation (elderly fall, domestic violence, lone worker) and get an AI-assisted risk read with a ready message for your trusted contacts; a hidden secret word acts as a silent alarm and a check-in timer raises an alert if you do not confirm in time. Self-contained web app + Capacitor (huawei build). Works offline; optional user-supplied AI key/endpoint for deeper analysis. Prototype: alarm sending is simulated, not a real emergency service — in danger call 112.
